'''Extensor arms''' were [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Manipulator arm/Legends|manipulators]] installed on [[Hound-W2 SPD]] [[Droid/Legends|droids]]. Each arm was capable of extending up to fifteen [[Meter/Legends|meters]] in length so that it could access difficult to reach areas. Each extensor arm was tipped by a different [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] module; a [[laser scan emitter]], a [[pulse scan emitter]], a [[thermal imager]], and a directionalized [[Audio sensor/Legends|audio receptor]].<ref name="EGTD" />
